cyd32-st7798.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 CYD 3.2 ST7798 R14.42 EVIDENCE + BUFFER SAFETY LAB — 369 RF Cases
cyd32-st7798.summary: R14.42 LAB CYD 3.2 ST7798: retained all 369 synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi emissions and the source-authenticated USB CATALOG/BUILD protocol. Corrected CYD 3.2 speech-bubble wrapping to fit its 32-byte detail buffer; tightened Windows receiver evidence scoring, CSV validity and checkpoint recovery; added fork/upstream expected-label selection and Freenove support. Production RF, receiver scan-health, LCD mirroring and hardware operation remain unverified. SHA-256 multi-part firmware flashing.
highlights: 369 selectable synthetic RF test cases, unchanged from R14.41 LAB baseline.
CYD 3.2 memory-safety correction: do not write 64 bytes into the 32-byte bubble detail buffer.
Explicit independent scan-window proof required before scoring receiver NONE; empty LOG never proves a negative.
Standalone scorer supports Freenove and 19 fork-only expected categories, independently of upstream v1.50.
Windows mirror session, stale-frame and capture-progress recovery hardened; desktop regression tests enabled.
BUILD source SHA and CATALOG/LIST_END fingerprints still required for USB source identity.
Physical RF fidelity, continuous scan health and exact hardware LCD accuracy require device validation.
